title: Cost-Aware Model Selection for Text Classification: Multi-Objective Trade-offs Between Fine-Tuned Encoders and LLM Prompting in Production
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study focused on the engineering and economic trade-offs (latency, cost, and F1 performance) of different NLP architectures. While it briefly mentions ethical and sustainability considerations in the discussion and conclusion (Section 5.5 and Section 6), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
